_comment: Add these rules to your Firebase RTDB security rules — needed for the v239 E2E self-healing re-key fix (see UPGRADE_NOTES_v239_E2EDecryptSelfHeal.md). No plaintext or key material ever goes through this node — just a per-partner timestamp meaning 'please re-key with me'.

rules_explanation.e2e_rekey_requests: e2e_rekey_requests/{targetUid}/{requesterUid} = ServerValue.TIMESTAMP. A device writes under the PARTNER's uid (targetUid) to ask them to re-key. Only the partner (targetUid) can read their own inbox. A request can be created only by the requester writing as themselves (requesterUid must equal their own auth.uid — can't spoof a request as someone else), and can be deleted (cleanup after processing) only by the target removing entries from their own inbox.
